results.name: Bodyweight Rear Lunge
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your hands on your hips or by your sides.
Step backward with your right foot and lower your body into a lunge position, ensuring your front knee is aligned over your ankle and your back knee is close to the floor.
Push through your front heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat the movement with your left foot stepping backward, alternating legs.
tips: Maintain an upright posture throughout the exercise to ensure proper form.
Ensure your front knee does not extend past your toes to avoid putting unnecessary strain on your knee.
Focus on smooth and controlled movements to enhance muscle engagement and prevent injury.
results.description: Bodyweight Rear Lunge is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.

results.name: Bodyweight Single Leg Deadlift
instructions: Stand with your feet together and your hands by your sides or on your hips.
Lift your right leg straight back and lean forward at the hips, keeping your back straight, until your torso is parallel to the floor.
Return to the starting position by lowering your right leg and raising your torso back to upright.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the left leg
tips: Maintain an upright posture and look forward to help with balance.
Keep a slight bend in your standing knee to avoid locking it and to protect your joints.
Focus on keeping your movements smooth and steady to maintain proper form and avoid injury.
results.description: Bodyweight Single Leg Deadlift is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back, Quadriceps.

results.name: Bodyweight Squat to Front Leg
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your hands extended down by your sides.
Lower your body into a squat position until your thighs are parallel to the floor, keeping your back straight.
Stand up from the squat and raise your right leg straight in front of you to hip level mimicking a kick, lower it down and immediately raise your left leg to hip level.
Lower your left leg back to the floor and repeat.
tips: Focus on maintaining an upright posture to ensure proper alignment and form.
Ensure your knees are aligned with your toes during the squat to prevent strain on your knees.
Move at a controlled pace, particularly when raising and lowering your leg, to avoid unnecessary strain and enhance muscle engagement.
results.description: Bodyweight Squat to Front Leg is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.

results.name: Bodyweight Squat to Side Leg
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your hands extended by your sides.
Lower your body into a squat position until your thighs are parallel to the floor, keeping your back straight.
Stand up from the squat and raise your right leg as high as possible, kicking it to the side until straight.
Lower your right leg back to the floor and immediately transition into the next squat, alternating legs with each repetition.
tips: Focus on maintaining an upright posture to ensure proper alignment and form.
Keep your weight distributed evenly on your feet during the squat to maintain balance.
Move at a controlled pace, particularly when raising and lowering your leg, to avoid unnecessary strain and enhance muscle engagement.
results.description: Bodyweight Squat to Side Leg is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.

results.name: Bodyweight Squat to Side to Front Leg
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your hands at your sides.
Lower your body into a squat position until your thighs are parallel to the floor, keeping your back straight.
Stand up from the squat and raise your right leg straight to the side, then lower it back to the floor.
Perform another squat, then stand up and raise your right leg straight to the front. Lower it back to the floor and repeat the movement, alternating legs with each repetition.
tips: Focus on engaging your core to maintain stability and balance throughout the exercise.
Keep your weight distributed evenly on your feet during the squat to maintain balance.
Move at a controlled pace, especially when lifting and lowering your leg, to avoid unnecessary strain and enhance muscle engagement.
results.description: Bodyweight Squat to Side to Front Leg is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.

results.name: Bodyweight Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your hands extended in front of you for balance.
Lower your body into a squat position until your thighs are parallel to the floor, keeping your back straight.
Stand back up to the starting position.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your feet flat on the floor to maintain balance and stability.
Ensure your knees are aligned with your toes during the squat to prevent strain on your knees.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
results.description: Bodyweight Squat is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.

Lower your body into a squat position until your thighs are parallel to the floor, keeping your back straight.
Stand back up to the starting position.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your feet flat on the floor to maintain balance and stability.
Ensure your knees are aligned with your toes during the squat to prevent strain on your knees.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
results.description: Bodyweight Squat (Front View) is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.

results.name: Bodyweight Squats Hold
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your hands crossed to your chest.
Lower your body into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
Hold the squat position for the desired duration, maintaining proper form throughout.
Stand back up to the starting position by pressing through your heels and straightening your legs.
tips: Focus on keeping your feet flat on the floor to ensure stability and proper form.
Ensure your knees are aligned with your toes during the squat to prevent strain on your knees.
Focus on steady breathing to help maintain the hold and prevent fatigue.
results.description: Bodyweight Squats Hold is a beginner multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.

results.name: Bodyweight Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your hands on your hips or by your sides for balance.
Rise up onto your toes, lifting your heels off the floor.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
Lower your heels back to the floor to return to the starting position.
tips: Keep your core engaged to maintain balance throughout the exercise.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation.
Ensure your weight is evenly distributed on both feet to prevent imbalance.
results.description: Bodyweight Standing Calf Raise is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the calves (lower legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shins, Shins.

results.name: Bodyweight Step-Up on Step Box
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart in front of a step box.
Step up onto the box with your right foot, then bring your left foot up to meet your right, standing fully on the box.
Step back down to the floor with your left foot, followed by your right foot.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, alternating the lead foot.
tips: Engage your core to maintain balance and stability throughout the exercise.
Ensure your entire foot is placed on the box to prevent slipping.
Focus on pushing through your heel when stepping up to activate your glutes and quadriceps.
results.description: Bodyweight Step-Up on Step Box is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.
